use_when: evidence shows a real mismatch between sources
canonical truth is not yet owner-confirmed
human confirmation is required before any remediation
do_not_use_when: both sources are intentionally transitional and documented
behavior is proven code defect against accepted authority
examples_in_pilot: registry vs legacy competence for Sandu

use_when: behavior may come from code, fixture, query, or comparator
business truth alone cannot resolve classification
response invariance or projection path is suspect
do_not_use_when: data/policy mismatch is already documented with stable evidence

use_when: dual-source coexistence is intentional during migration
mismatch is known and no immediate correction is justified
sources align on the probed dimension
do_not_use_when: owner has not accepted transitional policy for the entity

use_when: both data states are technically possible
owner must choose authority or rule
explicit mapping/hybrid mode creates eligibility without registry competence
do_not_use_when: one source is already owner-confirmed canonical

use_when: code/runtime behavior contradicts an accepted authority
do_not_use_when: fixture/seed state is the disputed truth

use_when: one or more required sources are absent
do_not_use_when: all comparator inputs were present in pilot scenario

decision_tree.question: Are all required comparator inputs present?
Do sources match on the probed dimension?
Is accepted canonical authority already owner-confirmed for this domain?
Does runtime contradict accepted authority with complete evidence?
Is mismatch caused by explicit policy choice (mapping/hybrid/transition)?
